features.quote: **Max turns:** 40. (One "turn" = one model message + tool execution.)
**Termination conditions:** (a) max turns, (b) model emits an explicit "I give up / cannot proceed" + stop token, (c) tests pass

This is a behavioral/safety-relevant finding (agents that spiral under failure are a real deployment risk: wasted compute, harmful outputs, give-up-when-shouldn't). Frame it as **reliability under adversity**
